turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can we look at the MCP Memory & Vault Tool Refactoring Plan? I'm worried the retrieval logic is getting bloated.
Sure, Alan. I've reviewed the current proposal. What specific parts concern you?
Mostly the search module. I feel like we are over-engineering it. tag_search is kept as-is because it is the fastest and most precise path for known topics.
Understood. I will note that preference for the refactoring strategy.
Also, did that package with the new NVMe drive arrive yet?
Checking the tracking info... yes, it was delivered this morning. It's on your desk.
Great. I'll install it after dinner. What's good for a quick pasta tonight?
I recommend a simple Aglio e Olio. Fast and uses pantry staples.
Perfect. Back to the code, keep this in mind for the draft.
